v: strI anu + mA--aN । parAmarSajYAnADIne (vyAptaDUmAdiliNgaviSizwajYAnADIne) jYAnaBede yaTA “parvato vahnimAnityAdi” taTAhi DUmAdihetO mahAnasAdO prAk BUyaHsahacAradarSanAt DUmatvavahnitvasAmAnyaDarmmeRa sakalavahniDUmAdivyAptiniScayaH anantaraM deSAntaraM gatavato vahnyarTinaH parvatAdO DUmadarSane sati tatra vahnivyAptismftirjAyate ekasambanDijYAnasyAparasambanDismArakatAyA niyamena, DUmadarSanAt DUmagatAyA vahnervyApteH smaraRasamBavAt । tatastAdfSaDUmavAn ayaM parvata iti niScayarUpaparAmarSena tatra vahnimAnayamiti niScinoti so'yaM niScayaH anumitirUpaH anuBavaBeda iti । tatra ca DUmAdiliNgajYAnameva karaRaM natu jYAyamAnaliNgaM karaRamiti navyanEyAyikasidDAntaH prAcInamate jYAyamAnaliNgameveti BedaH “anumAyAM jYAyamAnaM liNgaM tu karaRaM na hIti” BAzA॰ । “so'yaM niyantritArTatvAnna pratyakzaM na cAnumeti” Sa॰ Sa॰ pra॰ ।
m: 1. अनु-√ 2. मा Intens. (impf. अमीमेद् अनु) to roar or bleat towards, RV. i, 164, 28.
2. अनु-√ 3. मा to be behind in measure, to be unable to equal, RV. ; to infer, conclude, guess, conjecture: Pass. -मीयते, to be inferred or supposed.
3. अनु-मा f. inference, a conclusion from given premises.
a: अनुमा — {c3c} A., {c2c} P. 1 To infer, (as from some signs, premises &c.); अलिंगां प्रकृतिं त्वाहुर्लिंगैरनुमिमीमहे Mb.; conclude, guess, conjecture; धूमादग्निमनुमाय T. S. 41; पर्याकुलत्वान्मरुतां वेगभंगोऽनुमीयते Ku. 2. 25; R. 15. 77, 17. 11; तेजोविशेषानुमितां दधानः 2. 7, 68; 5. 12; Ki. 5. 47. --2 To reconcile, equal. --Caus. (-मापयति) To lead one to infer or guess, bespeak, indicate; आकृतिरेवानुमापयत्यमानुषतां K. 132, 202.
अनुमा — [मा-अङ्] Inference, conclusion from given premises; see अनुमिति.

m: अनु-माद्य (4, 5) mfn. to be praised in succession, to be granted with acclamation or praise, RV.; AV.
अनु-माद्य See अनु-√ मद्.
a: अनुमाद्य — pot. p. To be praised in succession, to be granted with praise.

m: अनु-मालिनी-तीरम् ind. on the bank of the Mālinī, Śak.

s: klI, (anu + mA + lyuw .) anumitikaraRaM । anumitiH । iti cintAmaRiH ॥ tatparyyAyaH । anumA 2 iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
v: na॰ anu--mi--mA--vA BAvAdO lyuw । vyApyasya jYAnena vyApakasya niScaye, yaTA vahnirDUmasya vyApaka iti DUmastasya vyApta ityevaM tayoH BUyaH sahacAraM pAkasTAnAdO dfzwvA paScAt parvatAdO udDUyamAnaSiKasya DUmasya darSane tatra vahnirastIti niScIyate । karaRe lyuwi । tadDetuBUte DUmAdO । “taccAnuBAnaM triviDamiti” cittAmaRiH । Srutereca svataH prAmARyaM, yatra SrutiH sAkzAt na SrUyate tatra smftivAkyAt SrutivAkyamanuBIyate iti SrutyanumApakaM smftivAkyamapyanumAnapadenABiDIyate iti mImAMsakAH । “viroDe tvanapekzamasati hyanumAnamiti jE॰ mU॰ । iyaM smftiH vedamUlikA AptavAkyatvAdityevamanumAnAkAraH iti । “dfzwamanumAnamAptavacanaYca sarvvapramARasidDatvAditi sA॰ kA॰ । “atIndriyasya sidDiranumAnAditi” sAMKya॰ sU॰ “pratyakzaparikalitamapyarTamanumAnena vuButsante” iti vAca॰ “pratyakzamanumAnaM ca SAstraYca viviDAgamamiti manuH । “evamanumAne nirUpite tasmAt puruzaDOreyasidDiriti” cintA॰ “nAnumAnaM rasAdInAmiti sA॰ da॰ “saparikara manumAnaM nirUpyeti” cintAmaRidIDitiH ।
m: 1. अनु-मान m. permission, consent, TBr.; Kāṭh.
2. अनु-मान n. the act of inferring or drawing a conclusion from given premises
inference, consideration, reflection
guess, conjecture
one of the means of obtaining true knowledge (see प्रमाण).
a: अनुमानं — 1 Inferring as the instrument of an अनुमिति, conclusion from given premises; an inference, conclusion; one of the four means of obtaining knowledge according to the Nyāya system; (अनुमितिकरणमनुमानं तच्च धूमो वह्निव्याप्य इति व्याप्तिज्ञानं. It is of two kinds स्वार्थानुमानं & परार्थानुमानं); प्रत्यक्षं चानुमानं च शास्त्रं च विविधागमं . त्रयं सुविदितं कार्यं धर्मशुद्धिमभीप्सता .. Ms. 12. 105. --2 A guess, conjecture, sign to know; इंगितैरनुमानैश्च मया ज्ञेया भविष्यति Rām. --3 Analogy, similarity; आत्मनो हृदयानुमानेन प्रेक्षसे Ś. 5 you judge (of others) by the analogy of your own heart; स्वानुमानात्कादंबरीमुत्प्रेक्ष्य K. 305. --4 (In Rhet.) A figure which consists in a notion, expressed in a peculiarly striking manner, of a thing established by proof; S. D. 711; यत्र पतत्यबलानां दृष्टिर्निशिताः पतंति तत्र शराः . तच्चापरोपितशरो धावत्यासां पुरः स्मरो मन्ये .. अनुमानं तदुक्तं यत्साध्यसाधनयोर्वचः K. P. 10. --Comp. --उक्ति f. reasoning; logical inference.

m: अनु-मान—खण्ड, n. or अनु-मान—चिन्तामणि, m. or अनु-मान—प्रकाश, m. works on अनुमान.

v: pu॰ gaNgeSopADyAyakfte nyAyaSAstrasyAnumAnatattvajYApake prakaraRaBede । tatra ca AdO anumitisvarUpAdinirUpaRaM tatastatkAraRavyAptijYAnArTaM vyAptinirUpaRam tatovyAptigrahopAyanirUpaRam tato vyAptigrahAnukUlatarkanirUpaRam, uktAsu bahvIzu vyAptizu kaTaNkAraM tAsAmanugamastannirUpaRam” tataH vyAptijYAnopAyatayA sAmAnyalakzaRAnirUpaRam tato hetoH pariSuqvijYAnArTamupADinirUpaRam । tato'numityaNgapakzatAnirUpaRam parArTAnumAnasya paYcAvayavanyAyasADyatayA tannirUpaRam । anumitO parAmarSasya (sADyavyAptimadDetuviSizwajYAnAtmakasya) svarUpAdinirUpaRam ॥ tatohetutrEviDyasya (kevalAnvayi kevalavyatirekyanvayavyatirekitvarUpasya) nirUpaRam tato varjjanIyatayA hetordozARAM (hetvABAsAnAm) nirUpaRam tatrAdO sAsAnyatohetvABAsalakzaRam tataH savyaBicArasya, sADAraRasya, asADAraRasya, anurUpasaMhAriRaH, asidDeSca kramaSaH, tato bADasya nirUpaRam ityetatparyyantaM saparikaramanumAnaM heyatayA taddozAMSca nirUpya tAdfSAnumAnena ISvarasya sidDirdarSitA tasyArADanasahakftena zoqaSapadArTa tattvajYAnenAtyantikaduHKanivfttirUpApavargasidDirityete padArTAH tatratyA avaDeyAH ।

m: अनु-मान—मणि-दीधिति f. a similar work written by Raghunātha.

s: strI, (anumAnena uktiH kaTanaM tatpuruzaH .) tarkaH । UhaH । iti halAyuDaH ॥
m: अनुमानोक्ति f. inferential argument, reasoning.
अनु-मापक mf(इका)n. causing an inference (as an effect).
a: अनुमापक — a. (पिका f.) Causing an inference as an effect, being the ground of an inference.

m: अनु-√ मार्ग् to search through, R.
अनु-मार्—˚गागत mfn. met half-way, Jātakam.

v: avya॰ mArge viBaktyarTe yATArTye, paScAdarTe vA avyayI॰ । mArge ityarTe, mArgAnurUpe, mArgasya paScAdarTe ca । “anumArgAgatAyAYceti” kAda॰ ।
m: अनु-मार्ग m. following, seeking (एण, with gen. = ‘after’), Kād.; Kathās.
a: अनुमार्गं — adv. Along the way, according to a (particular) way, on or in the way; अनुमार्गागतया K. 100 come by this way.

v: avya॰ vIpsArTe avyayI॰ । pratimAse, anumAse BavaH WaY । AnumAsikaH pratimAsaBave “piRqAnvAhAryyakaM SrAdDaM kuryyAnmAsAnumAsikam” iti manuH ।
a: अनुमासः — [अनुगतो मासः] The following month. --सं ind. Every month, month after month.

v: tri॰ anu + mA--tfc । anumAnakarttari “nahi kariRi dfzwe cItkAreRa tamanumimate'numAtAra” iti vAcaspatiH ।
m: अनु-मातृ mfn. drawing inferences, Śaṃk., Sch.
a: अनुमातृ — a. One who infers; न हि करिणि दृष्टे चीत्कारेण तमनुमिमतेऽनुमातारः.

v: avya॰ mAze viBaktyarTe avyayI॰ । mAze ityarTe । parimuKA॰ Yya । AnumAzyaH tadBavAdO tri॰ ।
a: अनुमाषं — adv. Like a kidney bean or in it.

m: अनु-माषम् ind. like a kidney bean, (g. परिमुखादि, q.v.)
अनु-मीयमान mfn. Pass. p. being inferred.
अनु-मध्यम mfn. next oldest to the middle, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 189, Sch.

a: अनुमंतृ — a. Consenting to, permitting, allowing, suffering (opp. to active agent); Bg. 13. 22; Ms. 5. 51 adviser.

अनुमंत्र् — {c10c} A. To consecrate or accompany with sacred hymns or magical formulas; to dismiss with sacred and auspicious words, dismiss with a blessing; विसृष्टश्च वामदेवानुमंत्रितोऽश्वः U. 2 (v. l. for अभिमंत्रित); रथमारोप्य कृष्णेन यत्र कर्णोऽ नुमंत्रितः Mb.
अनुमंत्रणं — Consecration by hymns and prayers.

m: अनु-√ मद् to rejoice over, to gladden, to praise, RV. &c.
a: अनुमद् — {c1c} P. Ved. To rejoice over, gladden.

m: अनु-√ मन् to approve, assent to, permit, grant: Caus. P. -मानयति, to ask for permission or leave, ask for (acc.), Yājñ.; to honour.
a: अनुमन् — {c4c} A. 1 To agree or consent to, comply with, approve, sanction, grant; to permit, allow; तत्र नाहमनुमंतुमुत्सहे मोघवृत्ति कलभस्य चेष्टितम् R. 11. 39; M. 1. 12; राजन्यान् स्वपुरनिवृत्तयेऽनुमेने R. 4. 87; 14. 20; शुश्रूषमाणां गिरिशोनुमेने Ku. 1. 59, 3. 60, 5. 68; कृताभिमर्षामनुमन्यमानः सुतां Ś. 5. 20; इमां स्वसारं च यवीयसीं मे कुमुद्वतीं नार्हसि नानुमंतुं R. 16. 85 be pleased not to reject or refuse; Bh. 3. 22. --2 To follow, have recourse to; धर्मार्थावभिसंत्यज्य संरभं योनुमन्यते Mb. --Caus. 1 To ask for leave or permission; ask the consent of; अनुमान्यतां महाराजः V. 2 ask for leave to go; take counsel with; भूयोऽपि सखीजनमनुमानयिष्यामि Ś. 3. --2 To ask for, request or beg; Y. 1. 240. --3 To honour. --4 To put to account.

m: अनु-मनन n. assenting, Nir.
a: अनुमननं — 1 Assent; sufferance. --2 Independence.

m: अनु-मन्तव्य mfn. to be consented to or acknowledged, Inscr.

v: tri॰ anu + mana--tfc । svayamudAsIne kAryyAdO pravfttasyAnyasyItsAhavardDanArTamanujYAkarttari । “anumantA viSasitA niyantA krayavikrayIti” manuH “upadrazwAnumantA ca BarttA BoktA maheSvara” iti gItA । “anumantA anumodayitEva sanniDimAtreRAnugrAhaka” iti SrIDaraH ।
m: अनु-मन्तृ mfn. consenting to, permitting, TBr. &c.
अनु-√ मन्त्र् to accompany with or consecrate by magic formulas; to dismiss with a blessing.

v: pu॰ anu mantroccAraRAt paScAt mantraRam mantreRa saMskArAdikaraRam । mantroccArapUrvvake yAgAdizu saMskAraBede “prayAjAnumantraRamiti” kAtyA॰ 3, 3, 2 ।
m: अनु-मन्त्रण n. consecration by hymns and prayers.
अनु-मन्त्रण—मन्त्र m. a hymn used in consecrating.
अनु-मन्त्रित mfn. so consecrated.
अनु-मन्यमान mfn. minding, assenting.
अनु-मर्शम् ind. so as to seize or take hold of ŚBr.; KātyŚr.

s: klI, (anu + mf + BAve lyuw .) paScAnmaraRaM । Barttari mfte tatpAdukAdikamAdAya jvalaccitArohaRapUrvvakaM striyA maraRaM । yaTA -- “deSAntaramfte patyO sADvI tatpAdukAdvayaM । niDAyorasi saMSudDA praviSet jAtavedasaM” ॥ iti brahmapurARaM ॥ brAhmaRyA nizeDamAha, smftiH । “pfTak citiM samAruhya na viprA gantumarhati” ॥ sahamaraRaM । mftaBarttrA saha jvalaccitArohaRapUrvvakaM striyA maraRaM । yaTA, -- “BartrAnumaraRaM kAle yAH kurvvanti taTAviDAH । kAmAtkroDAwBayAnmohAtsarvvAH pUtA Bavanti tAH” ॥ iti mahABArataM ॥
v: na॰ anu + mf--lyuw । Barttari mfte taddehAprAptO tatpAdukAdigrahaRena pfTakcitArohaRena strIRAM dehatyAge । “BarttrAnumaraRaM kAle yAH kurvvanti taTAviDAH । kAmAt kroDAt BayAdvApi sarvAH pUtAH Bavanti tAH” iti smftiH anupUrvvakamaraRasya maraRasadfSamaraRArTakatvena sakarmmakatvam ataeva “BavatA nAnumftApi laByate” iti raGO karmaRi ktaprayogaH । anumaraRaM ca BarttuH deSAntarAdimaraRe dehAdyalABe eva “deSAntare mfte patyO sADvI tatpAdukAdvayam । niDAyorasi saMSudDA praviSejjAtavedasamiti” smftiH । tatra kzatriyAdInAmevADikAro na viprAyAH, yaToktam । “pfTakcitAM samAruhya na viprA gantumarhatIti” Su॰ ta॰ smftO ।
m: अनु-मरण See अनु-√ मृ.
अनु-मरण n. following in death
post-cremation or concremation of a widow
the burning of a widow with (her husband's corpse or with part of his dress when his body is not on the spot; cf. सह-मरण).
a: अनुमरणं — See under अनुमृ.

अनुमरणं — Following in death; तन्मरणे चानुमरणं करिष्यामीति मे निश्चयः H. 3; post-cremation of a widow (अनुमरणं हि भर्तुर्देशांतरादिमरणे देहाद्यलाभ एव); देशांतरमृते पत्यौ साध्वी तत्पादुकाद्वयं . निधायोरसि संशुद्धा प्रविशेज्जातवेदसं .. This is allowed to Kṣatriya, Vaiśya and other women, but not to Brāhmaṇa women; पृथक् चितां समारुह्य न विप्रा गंतुमर्हति. Bāṇa severely condemns this practice; see K. 173-4.

m: अनु-मरिष्यत् mfn. about to follow in death.
अनु-मरु m. (used in the pl.) a country next to a desert, R. iv, 43, 19.
a: अनुमरुः — A country next to a desert.

v: tri॰ anu + mana--kta । svayaMpravftte idaM kriyatAmiti protsAhanArTamanujYAte । anumodite ca “kftamanumataM dfzwaM vA yEridaM guru pAtakamiti” veRI॰ । “guruRAnumataH snAtvA samAvftto yaTAviDi” iti manuH । “sagyagvinIyAnumato gfhAyeti” ca raGuH । “uBayAnumataH sAkzIti” smftiH ।
m: अनु-मत mfn. approved, assented to, permitted, allowed, agreeable, pleasant
loved, beloved
concurred with, being of one opinion
अनु-मत n. consent, permission, approbation
a: अनुमत — p. p. 1 Approved, assented to, agreed to, permitted, allowed, granted &c.; कृतमनुमतं दृष्टं वा यौरिदं गुरुपातकं Ve. 3. 22; ˚गमना Ś. 4. 9 allowed to depart; अनुमतो गृहाय R. 5. 10; उभय˚तः साक्षी Y. 2. 72 admitted by both parties &c. --2 Liked, beloved, pleasant, loved, agreeable, desired by, dear to; वृष्टिं च कर्षकजनानुमतां करोति Bṛ. S. 5. 72. --3 Being of one opinion, agreeing or concurring with. --तः A lover; घनमतो नमतोनुमतान् प्रियाः Śi. 6. 65. --तं Consent, approval, permission; प्रथमं कस्यानुमते चोरितमेतत्त्वया हृदयं V. 3. 17.

m: अनु-मत—कर्म-कारिन् mfn. doing what is allowed, acting according to an agreement.

s: [n] tri, (anumatamanujYAtaM karmma karmmaDArayaH, tatkaroti yaH anumatakarmma + kf + Rini upapadasamAsaH .) liKitapatrAdyanusAreRa karmmakarttA । AjYayA kAryyakarttA ca ॥ iti vyavahArakARqaM ॥ aCI iti AravI BAzA ।

m: अनुमत-वज्र mfn. one who has received the thunderbolt by consent (?), MaitrS.
अनु-मते ind. with consent of.

s: strI, (anu + man + BAve ktvin । kalAhInatve'pi pUrRimAvihitayAgAdikaraRAya anujYAyate'syAM anu + man + aDikaraRe ktin .) sammatiH । anujYA । nyUnendukalA pUrRimA । caturddaSIyuktA pUrRimA । iti medinI ॥ (“kuhvE cEvAnumatyE ca prajApataya eva ca । sahadyAvApfTivyoSca taTA svizwakfte'ntataH” ॥ iti manuH .)
v: strI anu + mana--ktin । anujYAyAm । “anumatyA vyapeyAditi” smftiH । anumanyate kalAhInatve'pi pfrRimAvihitayAgAdikaraRAyAnujYAyate 'syAm aDikaraRe ktin । kalAhonacandravatyAM SuklacaturdaSIyutapUrRRimAtiTO । anumato rAketi devapatnyAviti nEruktAH pOrRamAsyAviti yAjYikA yA pUrvvA pOrRamAsI sAnumatiryottarA sA rAketi vijYAyate ॥ anumatiranumananAt । “anumatirAkAsinIbAlIvu hUByaScarava” iti kA॰ 18, 6, 21, kuhvE “cEvAnumatyE ca prajApataya eva ceti” manuH ।
m: अनु-मति f. assent, permission, approbation
personified as a goddess, RV.; AV. &c.
the fifteenth day of the moon's age (on which it rises one digit less than full, when the gods or manes receive oblations with favour)
also personified as a goddess, VP., oblation made to this goddess.
a: अनुमतिः — f. 1 Permission, consent, approval, assent. --2 The 15th day of the moon's age on which she rises one digit less than full, when the gods and manes receive oblations with favour; personified as a goddess or worshipped in the Rājasūya sacrifice (कलाहीनचंद्रवती शुक्लचतुर्दशीयुतपूर्णिमातिथिः); अनुमत्यै हविरष्टाकपालं पुरोडाश निर्वपति Śat. Br.; Ms. 3. 86-87. --Comp. --पत्रं a deed expressing assent.

k.v: कलाहीने सानुमतिः पूर्णे राका निशाकरे। अमावास्या त्वमावस्या दर्शः सूर्येन्दुसङ्गमः॥

m: अनु-मति—पत्त्र n. (in law) a deed expressing assent.

a: अनुमत्त — p. p. Intoxicated with joy.

v: tri॰ anumIyate'sO anu + mi--karmmaRi yat । anumityarhe, anumAtuM yogye “etAvatA nanvanumeyaSoBIti” kumA॰ । “PalAnumeyAH prAramBAH saMskArAH prAktanA iva” iti raGuH ।
m: अनु-मेय mfn. to be measured, AV. vi, 137, 2
inferable, to be inferred, proved or conjectured.
a: अनुमेय — pot. p. Inferable, to be inferred; फलानुमेयाः प्रारंभाः R. 1. 20.

m: अनु-√ मृ to follow in death, TBr. &c.
a: अनुमृ — {c6c} A. To follow in death; रुदता कुत एव सा पुनर्भवता नानुमृतापि लभ्यते R. 8. 85 followed in death by you; गतिविभ्रमसादनीरवा न शुचा नानुमृतेव लक्ष्यते 58 (used actively).

m: अनु-√ मृश् to grasp, seize, RV. &c.; to consider, think of, reflect: Caus. -मर्शयति, to touch or take hold of for the sake of examining, Kāṭh.
अनुमृग्य mfn. (√ मृग्), to be sought after, BhP.
अनुमृग्य—दाशु mfn. granting all that is sought.
अनु-√ मृज् to rub lengthways for polishing or cleaning, AV.; ŚBr. &c. Intens. part. -मर्मृजान, stretching (the arms) repeatedly towards, RV. x, 142, 5.
अनु-मृत् mfn. dying after, following in death, Ragh.
अनु-मृता f. the woman who burns with a part of her husband's dress.

अनु-√ मुद् to join in rejoicing, RV. viii, 1, 14, &c.; to sympathize with, to rejoice; to allow with pleasure, express approval, applaud, permit: Caus. -मोदयति, to express approval, permit.
a: अनुमुद् — {c1c} A. (P. in epic poetry) 1 To rejoice with, join in rejoicing or sympathizing with; मुदितामनुमोदते Bhāg. --2 To express approval; तदेव राममातृभिरनुमोदितं U. 2; approve, second, applaud; निषेद्धुमासीदनुमोदितुं वा R. 14. 43; to allow with pleasure, permit; अनुमोदितमाचार्यैः K. 77; अननुमोदितामात्रा 160. --Caus. To gladden, delight, favour, permit.

m: अनु-√ मुह् to feel distressed at, to be troubled about or after another, MBh. i, 143.
